project_type: Go backend (Go 1.26.5) + Angular v22 frontend - Vulnerability intelligence tool
build_system: make (Go), pnpm (Angular UI). See Makefile targets: build, test, lint, fmt, test-integration
test_framework: go test with table-driven tests (unit), integration tests with //go:build integration tag, Vitest for Angular
verification_instructions: 1. Validate JSON files with jq. 2. Validate YAML files with yaml syntax check. 3. Check that all referenced paths exist. 4. Verify markdown renders properly.
setup_instructions: No build setup needed - this task creates configuration files only (JSON, YAML, Markdown)
environment_constraints: This is a configuration/documentation task. No Go compilation or DB needed. Files created: .kiro/agents/*.json, .kiro/steering/*.md, .github/workflows/*.yml
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns in .kiro/steering/ for markdown. YAML workflows follow kiro-action conventions. Agent JSON follows .kiro/agents/<name>.json pattern used by kiro-cli --agent flag.
key_patterns: Steering files: plain markdown in .kiro/steering/. MCP config: .kiro/settings/mcp.json. Existing GitHub Actions: ci.yml, kiro.yml, release.yml. Agent definitions: .kiro/agents/<name>.json (used via kiro-cli chat --agent <name>). Workflow prompts in GitHub Actions use kiro-action with explicit prompt: input.
directory_structure: .kiro/steering/ - steering files for agent behavior guidance. .kiro/settings/ - MCP server config. .github/workflows/ - CI/CD and Kiro automation. .agents/tasks/ - task plans from prior work. cmd/mayu/ - CLI entrypoint. internal/ - Go packages. ui/ - Angular frontend. docs/ - documentation. migrations/ - SQL migrations.
